# Best Off-Grid Solar System Packages

An **off-grid solar system package** typically includes solar panels, a hybrid or off-grid inverter, battery storage, and electrical protection equipment. Unlike a standard grid-tied system, it can supply electricity without a utility connection.

The right package depends on whether you're powering a cabin, RV, tiny home, or full-size house.

## Recommended system sizes

| System size | Battery storage | Best for | Estimated package cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1–2 kW | 2–5 kWh | RVs, sheds, small cabins | $1,500–$4,000 |
| 3–5 kW | 5–10 kWh | Cabins, tiny homes | $4,000–$9,000 |
| 6–8 kW | 10–20 kWh | Small off-grid homes | $8,000–$16,000 |
| 10–12 kW | 20–30 kWh | Full-size homes | $13,000–$25,000 |
| 15–20 kW | 30–60 kWh | Large homes, high energy usage | $22,000–$45,000+ |

<text color="secondary" size="xs">Approximate US equipment-budget ranges, not live quotes. Installation, permitting, shipping, and backup generators may cost extra.</text>
